task.description: Fix off-by-one in CharField.max_length validator that rejects strings of exactly max_length.
task.instruction: The validator rejects values whose length equals max_length. Fix this so it only rejects values strictly longer than max_length. Update the test.
task.rubric: Test suite passes; patch only touches the validator and its test.

content.text: Found it. The bug is `>=` should be `>`. Applying the patch and updating the test.

arguments.diff:
--- a/django/core/validators.py
+++ b/django/core/validators.py
@@
-    if len(value) >= max_length:
+    if len(value) > max_length:
         raise ValidationError('Value too long')
--- a/tests/test_validators.py
+++ b/tests/test_validators.py
@@
-    self.assertRaises(ValidationError, max_length_validator, 'abcde', 5)
+    max_length_validator('abcde', 5)  # exactly max_length must be accepted
+    self.assertRaises(ValidationError, max_length_validator, 'abcdef', 5)
